bio: Michael John LiPetri (born July 10, 1990) is an American Republican attorney and politician from New York State who served one term as a New York State Assemblyman from the 9th district from 2019 to 2021.
offices: Member of the New York State Assembly

items.t: Co-sponsored legislation letting college students deduct college supplies, including textbooks, from their taxes.
items.q: LiPetri cosponsored legislation to let college students deduct college supplies—including textbooks—from their taxes.

items.t: Participated in a ride-along with ICE officers on Long Island.
items.q: LiPetri participated in a ride-along with ICE officers on Long Island.

items.t: Called for New York Health Commissioner Howard Zucker to be fired over the nursing home COVID-19 patient policy, and called for a federal investigation of it (2020).
items.q: LiPetri called for New York Health Commissioner Howard Zucker to be fired as a result of this policy, and called for a federal investigation of this policy

items.t: Sponsored a bill to ban products containing 1,4-dioxane, a carcinogen found in Long Island tap water; the bill passed and was signed into law.
items.q: LiPetri sponsored a bill in the Assembly to ban the usage of products that contain 1,4-dioxane: a carcinogen found in tap water on Long Island.

items.t: Co-sponsored and voted for a bill making it easier for public water suppliers to sue polluters for contaminating water supplies; it was signed into law.
items.q: LiPetri also cosponsored and voted for a bill to make it easier for public water suppliers to sue polluters for contaminating water supplies.

items.t: Introduced a bill to make it a felony to assault a police officer with water or any other liquid (state Assembly).
items.q: LiPetri introduced a bill to make it a felony to assault a police officer with water or any other liquid

items.t: Criticized New York's bail reform law.
items.q: LiPetri has criticized New York's bail reform law, which eliminates cash bail for certain misdemeanors

items.t: Co-sponsored, as one of two assemblymen, a bill to increase penalties for sex crimes involving a minor.
items.q: LiPetri was one of two assemblymen to sponsor a bill to increase penalties for sex crimes involving a minor.

items.t: Co-sponsored the "Learning for Work" Act to establish a youth apprenticeship program for occupations not requiring a college education.
items.q: LiPetri also cosponsored the "Learning for Work" Act to establish a youth apprenticeship program
